claim.supported_scope: Historical schema-3 percentile-only compatibility identity for seeded nonparametric case bootstrap; existing results remain readable but current desktop controls do not emit this recipe.
claim.estimand: The empirical distribution of each supported free CB-SEM parameter across admissible full-ML fits from exactly B preplanned primary case-resampling draws, with bootstrap standard error, two-sided percentile interval, and the conditioning failure rate reported explicitly.
assumptions: The original cbsem_ml_v1 fit is converged, identified, finite, and admissible.
Rows are independent sampling units and each replicate resamples n complete rows with replacement before recomputing moments and refitting.
At least max(1000, ceil(0.90 B)) requested replicates converge to admissible estimates under the frozen optimizer contract.
exclusions: Ordinal/WLSMV, robust, FIML, clustered, multilevel, parametric, BCa, studentized, and automatic model-modification bootstrap are excluded from this historical standalone identity.
The current Recipe-v4 exact-CFA family cbsem_exact_case_bootstrap_v1 and its studentized/BCa sidecars are separate identities and are never relabeled as v2.
Bollen-Stine null-transformed fit inference is distinct, and the cbsem_bootstrap_v1 normal-interval preview is not a bootstrap and cannot be promoted or relabeled as v2.
warnings: This identity is archive compatibility only and is not selectable for a new calculation.
Bootstrap validity depends on independent representative rows and stable admissible refits; all historical failed replicates and their reasons remain visible.

references.citation: Efron (1979), Bootstrap Methods: Another Look at the Jackknife, DOI 10.1214/aos/1176344552
Bollen and Stine (1992), Bootstrapping Goodness-of-Fit Measures in Structural Equation Models, DOI 10.1177/0049124192021002004
Independent NumPy/SciPy covariance-ML case-resampling and full-refit CB-SEM bootstrap reference, with a second independent lavaan distributional comparison

simulations.design: Supported CFA and recursive SEM models across sample size, loading/path magnitude, normal and moderately nonnormal continuous data, and optimizer stress.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen independent data-generation and replicate streams indexed by scenario, replicate, and bootstrap index.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Bias and coverage must meet preregistered Monte Carlo limits, every failed replicate must be counted, and payloads below the usable threshold must emit no interval.

simulations.design: Singular resamples, Heywood cases, nonconvergence, cancellation, and threshold-boundary cases.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen adversarial fixtures plus exactly B deterministic primary draws; failed fits have no replacement draw.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Every failure class and threshold decision must match the contract, no failed draw may be replaced, and a same-seed run restart must reproduce uninterrupted output.

boundaries.case: One or more resamples have singular covariance, nonconvergence, non-finite estimates, or inadmissible variances.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Each runtime replicate is reason-coded and counted. A below-threshold completed run persists inference status unavailable, an empty interval array, the stored successful-fit witness, and the stored failed-replicate ledger; archive validation checks their structural/accounting consistency without replaying fit semantics.

boundaries.case: The base model uses an unqualified estimator, group design, FIML, clustering, interaction, or requested B outside 1,000 through 10,000.
The same observations are imported in a different row order, yielding a separately fingerprinted positional sampling frame.
boundaries.expected_behavior: The run has a distinct fingerprint and stream; estimator bias, failure rate, and interval behavior must remain within preregistered Monte Carlo tolerances rather than claiming byte-identical mapped resamples.

boundaries.case: The same data, model, scientific settings, and seed execute with different worker counts.
boundaries.expected_behavior: The analytical bootstrap-v2 payload and validation witness are exactly equal; worker count may differ only in outer run provenance.

boundaries.case: An archive identity, sample-position hash, count, interval, threshold, recipe/provenance field, or checksum is changed without consistently updating all bound structural and derived fields.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Project validation rejects the structurally inconsistent archive; this boundary does not claim full-ML semantic replay authentication.

boundaries.case: A successful stored replicate estimate is changed together with its derived summaries, percentile intervals, and outer checksum, or an allowed failure reason/message is substituted consistently.
boundaries.expected_behavior: The structural validator may accept a coordinated rewrite because unsigned local archives do not rerun each sampled ML fit or provide trusted-origin authentication; this historical v2 identity remains non-promotional regardless.

tamper_tests.expected_behavior: Reject an archive whose identity differs from CB-SEM bootstrap v2.
Reject a result relabeled from cbsem_bootstrap_v1 or another method.
Reject resamples whose base dataset fingerprint differs from saved input.
Reject an archive entry whose stored recipe, replicate, or result checksum differs; a consistently rewritten unkeyed checksum is outside this structural claim.

Reject duplicate keys, unknown fields, invalid counts, non-finite estimates, unsorted quantiles, or structurally inconsistent failure accounting. Do not claim that stored successful-fit estimates or allowed failure meanings are authenticated against coordinated rewrites: an allowed failure-code/message substitution is not replayed, and persistence qualification remains failed until replay or equivalent authentication is qualified.
Never reinterpret analytical estimate plus or minus 1.96 standard errors from cbsem_bootstrap_v1 as resampling evidence.

persistence.legacy_policy: The cbsem_bootstrap_v1 preview remains explicitly experimental and is permanently ineligible for v2 evidence or migration.

applicability_blockers: Original fit not converged or admissible
native.gui_cli_parity_rule: GUI and CLI must produce identical worker-independent replicate streams, fits, failures, and bootstrap summaries for the same recipe and seed.
accessibility_rules: Interval and failure visuals have equivalent accessible tables.
Unavailable inference, failed counts, and warnings are communicated without color alone.
